Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: After successfully reaching the Wayback Machine and submitting the Virtue site URL (step 9), WebSurfer failed to proceed to a specific archived snapshot (e.g., selecting March 22, 2021 and April 21, 2021 or using direct snapshot URLs like web/20210322*/https://www.virtuerestaurant.com/menus). Instead, it fell into a loop of repeating vague search/refinement instructions and later cited unverified “technical issues,” never extracting or comparing the menus. This ineffective navigation and looping behavior prevented identifying the correct main course (shrimp), leading to the wrong outcome.
